title: Demonic Oni Warrior
description: A massive muscular oni demon with red skin, large curved horns, and flowing white hair stands triumphantly in a destroyed battlefield. He raises a glowing blue ethereal katana high while surrounded by swirling red and white energy trails, blue orbs, and a ground littered with skulls, bones, and broken wooden structures.
prompt: A towering muscular red-skinned oni demon with large black horns, long flowing white hair with green accents, and glowing red eyes roars with an open mouth while raising a large ornate katana that glows with bright blue ethereal energy and runes. He wears intricate dark armor with glowing orange patterns and a red sash, surrounded by swirling trails of red and white smoke-like energy with floating blue orbs. The ground is covered in piles of human skulls, bones, broken wooden fences and debris under a dark stormy sky with red lightning.
